jobs.description:
As a Private Banker Assistant, you will support Private Bankers in managing client relationships and ensuring smooth daily operations.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Brussels Capital Wealth is a boutique wealth management firm based in Brussels, supporting affluent individuals and entrepreneurs with personalized banking and investment solutions. We combine financial expertise with a high level of client service in an international and dynamic environment.

Omschrijving

• Support Private Bankers in managing client portfolios.
• Prepare client meetings and reports.
• Handle account opening and KYC documentation.
• Follow up on client requests and transactions.
• Coordinate with Compliance and Operations teams.
• Maintain accurate client records.
• Provide high-quality administrative and client support.

• A background in banking, financial services, or a related field.
• Minimum 2 years of experience in banking or financial services.
• Strong organizational and communication skills.
• Client-oriented and proactive mindset.
• Fluent in French or Dutch.
• Good level of English.
• Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

An organisation operating in the industrial/manufacturing industry based in Wijnegem. Accessible by car and public transportation.

Jobomschrijving

As a Supply Chain Officer your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate procurement activities to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
• Monitor inventory levels and manage stock replenishment processes effectively.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal departments to forecast demand and plan supply accordingly.
• Organizing transportation of raw materials and finished goods.
• Analyse and optimise supply chain processes to improve efficiency.
• Handle documentation and administrative tasks related to procurement and supply chain management.

A successful Supply Chain Officer should have:

• A strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Experience in the industrial/manufacturing sector is beneficial.
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and execute manufacturing improvement and process optimization projects while managing multiple priorities.
• Identify production bottlenecks, implement practical solutions, and deliver measurable operational improvements.
• Drive automation initiatives by evaluating, improving, and supporting industrial control systems and automation solutions.
• Provide technical expertise to production, quality, maintenance, and commercial teams, including support for quality issues and new product feasibility assessments.
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, aligned with business objectives, and contribute to long-term operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment with expertise in project management, process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to prioritize and deliver quick results.
• Good knowledge of SolidWorks and experience working with industrial machinery and manufacturing processes.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Become a Forklift Operator at a Sustainable Recycling Company
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you’ll join an innovative plastic recycling company where sustainability and circular economy are at the heart of what we do. In this role, you’ll be responsible for moving plastic waste around the site, loading and unloading trucks, and performing minor technical maintenance. Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. You’ll use a wheel loader and forklift to efficiently process plastic waste. Flexibility is important, as the shift schedule can vary slightly. Please note, the nature of recycling means the work environment can be less clean and sometimes involve odors. You’ll handle small technical issues yourself, while a maintenance technician is available for larger problems.

Are you ready to put your technical skills to good use and make a positive impact on the environment? Apply now and make a difference as an operator in the recycling industry!

• You have a valid forklift license

• You speak good English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

• You work accurately and value safety

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

As a CE Truck Driver Concrete Mixer, you'll be responsible for loading, transporting, and unloading fresh concrete at various construction sites. You'll work with a modern fleet of Volvo trucks and receive clear schedules and routes from the headquarters, so you can perform your tasks efficiently and safely.

Your day begins at one of the advanced production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem, where you'll load the concrete mixer. Next, you'll drive to different construction sites, mainly in Brussels and Antwerp. Sometimes you'll deliver in city centers with limited access, but you'll always receive clear instructions and support. You'll make sure that fresh concrete is delivered on time and in perfect condition, and you'll handle all transport documentation accurately.

Are you ready to play a key role in the construction sector, with plenty of responsibility and variety? Apply now and strengthen the team as a CE Truck Driver!

• Valid CE driver's license and driver card

• Experience as a CE driver, including accurate completion of transport documentation

• Able to communicate effectively in English

• Motivated and physically fit for the job

• Confident navigating urban environments and complex routes

• Completed at least lower or higher secondary education

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience, up to a maximum of 5 years

• Looking for a full-time opportunity

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks
